selection: Same 8-subject validation split, same 10240 validation windows, Huber loss for checkpoint selection every 2000 steps. No test-based model or budget selection. All seeds and failed runs retained.
augmentation: Independent NumPy RNG for per-window uniform yaw [-pi, pi); rotate gyro xy, accelerometer xy and velocity labels together, no augmentation of validation.

pca_control.label: Mixed-sensor PCA frame (adapted)
pca_control.shared_construction: Concatenate horizontal gyro and acceleration into 2T samples, joint centering, two orthonormal PCA directions, transform input and inverse-transform output. Frame is computed before GN.
adaptations: Exact symmetric 2x2 eigensolver on CPU instead of randomized low-rank PCA
Common ResNet18, GN and 2D velocity loss; no TLIO covariance head or EKF
pca_control.sign_policy: Use solver axes, descending eigenvalues, no third-moment sign correction; no claim of exact EqNIO reproduction

budget_policy.scope: Six prespecified seed-0 40000-step runs, new OneCycle schedule; sensitivity evidence, not a replacement for four-seed primary results.
budget_policy.material_change_rule: Relative reduction of validation Huber loss >5% for any compared family, or change of the best ResNet frontend under validation loss, triggers NEEDS_BUDGET_EXTENSION status; do not label the manuscript submission-ready until the material budget dependence is resolved.
budget_policy.reason: Bound the first training batch while exposing rather than hiding unresolved convergence concerns.

statistics.subject_id: Sequence prefix, cross-check against dataset subject metadata where available
statistics.bootstrap: 10000 paired subject cluster resamples after four-seed average; report conditional uncertainty and seed differences separately
statistics.multiplicity: Two primary HN contrasts (yaw, mixed PCA) per two primary datasets; Holm adjustment if p-values are used; other contrasts descriptive

reporting: No claim of first PCA/skewness construction, superior data efficiency, state-of-the-art superiority, raw-IMU standalone deployment, or untouched confirmation. Report learned EqNIO as not experimentally reproduced.
